subject: Follow-up: please share org chain + economic buyer for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Evans <claire.evans@novah.org>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@novah.org>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: please share org chain + economic buyer for NovaHealth

Hi Claire —

Great to meet you and Tom on the demo earlier today. Thanks for walking through the primary pain points (high tail latency on peak throughput and the need for deterministic cost forecasts for run-rate budgeting). As discussed, Redwood’s running-time stitching and cache recommendations can reduce per-token cost while meeting the 95th percentile latency target you mentioned.

Quick follow-up items so we can line up next steps: 
- Can you share a high-level org chart (who owns AI/ML, infra, legal/security, and procurement for clinical products)?
- Who is the economic buyer for vendor commitments (budget owner for 2027 AI infra spend)?
- Who should we engage on security evidence (SOC2, audit logs, network isolation)?
- Any procurement contact or contract lead to add to the thread so we can start a mutual action plan?

What I’ll do: put together a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) with proposed milestones: tech validation (30–45 min), security review, contract review, procurement & PO. If you can point to the right people or drop an org chart, I’ll wire in the dates.

Proposed near-term slots for the tech touch: Tue Apr 13 or Wed Apr 14, 10–11am PT. Does either work for Tom and your engineering lead?

Thanks — appreciate the quick help on the intro chain.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0189
https://www.redwood.ai

Attachments: (referenced in follow-up)
- demo-notes.pdf (slide clip)
From: Claire Evans <claire.evans@novah.org>

Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: please share org chain + economic buyer for NovaHealth

Thanks Priya — good session yesterday. Quick answers inline and attached an org chart to help.

Hi Priya,

Appreciate the recap. I attached a current org chart (Nova_OrgChart_Q1.pdf). High-level answers:
- Economic buyer: Tom Briggs (Head of AI Platforms) — he signs larger platform commitments; his email is tom.briggs@novah.org.
- Security/contact for evidence: Marta Lopez, Head of Infosec (marta.lopez@novah.org) — she owns SOC2/supply chain reviews. We also keep a running CSV of primary security contacts; see NOVA-security_contacts.csv attached.
- Procurement/PO: purchasing@novah.org — they run PO issuance for platform vendors (low-touch for SaaS, more process for reserved capacity).

We can loop Tom and Marta into the MAP review — Tom will want a quick ROI/contract talk; Marta will want a security checklist and a 30–45 minute walkthrough of architecture + data residency.

For next steps, I’m fine with Tue Apr 13 10am PT for the tech walkthrough; I’ll add Tom if he confirms.

Best,
Claire Evans
Director of Data Platforms | NovaHealth
claire.evans@novah.org | (617) 555-0199

Attachments:

Thanks Claire — really helpful, and thanks for the attachments. I pulled the two items into our MAP draft (link below) and proposed the timeline. Quote of the proposed MAP milestones: 

1) Tech validation (30–45 min): Apr 13, 10–10:45am PT — architecture walkthrough + perf profile expectations
2) Security evidence exchange & walkthrough (45 min): Apr 15 or 16 — Marta to set agenda items (SOC2 docs, logging, network model)
3) Commercial/PO discussion (Tom + procurement): week of Apr 19 — estimated T-shirt pricing & reserved capacity options
4) Contract review & legal redlines: week of Apr 26

Action items for Claire/Tom: please confirm Tom as economic buyer on this thread (or share the correct owner). If procurement prefers a different contact than purchasing@novah.org, let us know and we’ll add them to the MAP.

Vanessa — copying you for scheduling and to start the HubSpot MAP (I included the HubSpot company link below). Aditya — will you lead the tech walkthrough and bring a short security checklist?

HubSpot company: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/7654321

Thanks — happy to adjust the timeline if Tom prefers different dates.
